# Comparative Analysis of NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel Annual Revenues and Operating Incomes

**Mixed**

NVDA revenue for the fiscal period ended 2026-01-25 was $215.938 billion [E1ee42e5595](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000021/0001045810-26-000021-index.html), up from $130.497 billion for 2025-01-26 [E47912effca](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/0001045810-25-000023-index.html). NVDA net income for the fiscal period ended 2026-01-25 was $120.067 billion [Eef3b5c67c4](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000021/0001045810-26-000021-index.html), up from $72.880 billion for 2025-01-26 [Ebc64b283ab](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/0001045810-25-000023-index.html).

## What was knowable then

As of the March 1, 2025 viewpoint, NVIDIA's latest filed annual report for the fiscal period ended January 26, 2025 (filed February 26, 2025) reported revenue of $130,497,000,000 and operating income of $81,453,000,000 [Eaf78097930](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/0001045810-25-000023-index.html) [Ed26891b1f6](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/0001045810-25-000023-index.html). AMD's latest annual report for the fiscal period ended December 28, 2024 (filed February 5, 2025) reported revenue of $25,785,000,000 and operating income of $1,900,000,000 [E7f0d407567](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248825000012/0000002488-25-000012-index.html) [Ebc212f1281](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248825000012/0000002488-25-000012-index.html). Intel's latest annual report for the fiscal period ended December 28, 2024 (filed January 31, 2025) reported revenue of $53,101,000,000 and an operating loss of -$11,678,000,000 [E0a7a8b131a](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086325000009/0000050863-25-000009-index.html) [E63b9df5055](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086325000009/0000050863-25-000009-index.html).

## What happened later

Subsequent filings extending past the outcome cutoff revealed further operational updates. For the fiscal period ended January 25, 2026 (filed February 25, 2026), NVIDIA reported revenue of $215,938,000,000 and operating income of $130,387,000,000 [E1ee42e5595](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000021/0001045810-26-000021-index.html) [Effb397ce53](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000021/0001045810-26-000021-index.html). For the fiscal period ended December 27, 2025 (filed February 4, 2026), AMD reported revenue of $34,639,000,000 and operating income of $3,694,000,000 [E99f77b20a8](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248826000018/0000002488-26-000018-index.html) [E9981b97b1c](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248826000018/0000002488-26-000018-index.html). For the fiscal period ended December 27, 2025 (filed January 23, 2026), Intel reported revenue of $52,853,000,000 and an operating loss of -$2,214,000,000 [E523c845704](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086326000011/0000050863-26-000011-index.html) [E48a74e5f9f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086326000011/0000050863-26-000011-index.html).

## The peer test

Comparing annual revenue trajectories through the latest available annual periods demonstrates diverging business paths across the semiconductor peers. NVIDIA's revenue expanded substantially from $10,918,000,000 (period ended 2020-01-26, filed 2020-02-20) to $215,938,000,000 (period ended 2026-01-25, filed 2026-02-25) [E5b35cb19d3](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581020000010/0001045810-20-000010-index.html) [E1ee42e5595](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000021/0001045810-26-000021-index.html). AMD's revenue grew from $9,763,000,000 (period ended 2020-12-26, filed 2021-01-29) to $34,639,000,000 (period ended 2025-12-27, filed 2026-02-04) [Ec6b48dc63b](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000162828021001185/0001628280-21-001185-index.html) [E99f77b20a8](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248826000018/0000002488-26-000018-index.html). Conversely, Intel's revenue contracted from $77,867,000,000 (period ended 2020-12-26, filed 2021-01-22) down to $52,853,000,000 (period ended 2025-12-27, filed 2026-01-23) [E51518c9e84](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086321000010/0000050863-21-000010-index.html) [E523c845704](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086326000011/0000050863-26-000011-index.html).

## Cross-examination

Certain qualitative expectations, such as NVIDIA's anticipated increase in fiscal 2026 capital expenditures or unverified future lease obligations, cannot be validated as a strict quantitative promise due to missing explicit capex tags or segmented line items [Ed0b1b60a59] [E8333db2183](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/nvda-20250126.htm) [E1dab01d3c9](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/nvda-20250126.htm). Furthermore, general descriptive statements regarding customer programs or product shipment expectations function as directional commentary rather than standalone financial guidance metrics [Ec4801f62e1](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/nvda-20250126.htm) [E3f911c4284](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581024000264/nvda-20240728.htm).

## Limits

- As-of known-then management transcripts for NVDA, AMD, and INTC as of 2025-03-01 are missing.
- No annual USD capex line item was retrieved for NVIDIA under the supported XBRL tags.
